name: Elétrico Festival After Party
description: The party doesn't stop when the festival closes. Keep the energy going at the official after-party at Switch with a set from S.O.N.S.
longDescription:
The Elétrico Festival After Party at Switch extends the musical experience of the main festival. This official post-festival event provides a dedicated space for attendees to continue their evening, featuring a performance by S.O.N.S. The DJ and producer S.O.N.S. is known for his contributions to the electronic music scene, with releases on labels such as S.O.N.S. and his own imprint.

Attendees can expect an energetic atmosphere as the music continues into the early hours. The event is designed for those who wish to prolong the festival's momentum, attracting an audience interested in electronic music and late-night entertainment. Switch, located in the heart of Porto, functions as a contemporary nightlife venue, providing a setting for this type of musical event.

Ticket prices vary for this event. Switch is situated in central Porto, accessible via public transport. It is approximately a 5-minute walk from Trindade metro station, a central hub for various metro lines.
